cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Leave that letter under my plate. We only just managed breakfast together again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother cancelled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I've covered this month's rent. We don't need another suitcase in the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please finish breakfast with me first. Yesterday you finally unpacked; I can't risk you packing again.

mechanism: A professionally separates paid-rent verification from a concealed family-loan letter to protect a newly fragile reconciliation from another fight.
confusable: D61 hides personal blame; D87 hides truth because A believes another conflict would break the relationship.
comparison: Savings alternative prevents bank verification to preserve anniversary togetherness; letter alternative withholds contents during recently resumed breakfast.
seedUse: Letter under plate, brother repayment, covered rent and unpacked suitcase derive from D87-a; S03 adds payment-versus-correspondence correction.
